# Commit — Supply Chain Trust Scoring

> Score npm, PyPI, Cargo, and Go packages on behavioral signals that stars,
> READMEs, and vulnerability databases miss. Free CLI, API, MCP server,
> GitHub Action, and IDE hooks.

## What it does

Commit scores packages 0–100 on behavioral commitment: publisher depth,
release consistency, download trends, maintenance longevity, and OpenSSF
Scorecard data. Packages with a single npm publisher controlling millions
of weekly downloads are flagged CRITICAL — the exact pattern behind the
axios (March 30 2026) and LiteLLM (March 2026) supply chain attacks.

## Why it matters

26 npm packages with 10M+ weekly downloads have a single publisher.
`npm audit` and Dependabot don't flag this. Scorecard measures process
security, not credential-concentration risk. Commit fills the gap.

## Quick start

CLI (zero install):
  npx proof-of-commitment axios chalk zod

CI gate:
  npx proof-of-commitment --fail-on=critical

File scan (auto-detects npm/yarn/pnpm/pip/cargo/go):
  npx proof-of-commitment --file package-lock.json

## API

POST https://poc-backend.amdal-dev.workers.dev/api/audit
Content-Type: application/json

  {"packages": ["axios", "zod", "chalk"]}

Returns: score, maintainers, weeklyDownloads, ageYears, trend, riskFlags,
scorecardScore, scoreBreakdown for each package.

No API key needed for up to 200 requests/day.

## MCP Server

Remote (Streamable HTTP — no install):
  https://poc-backend.amdal-dev.workers.dev/mcp

Claude Desktop config:
  {"mcpServers": {"commit": {"type": "streamable-http", "url": "https://poc-backend.amdal-dev.workers.dev/mcp"}}}

9 tools: audit_dependencies, lookup_npm_package, lookup_pypi_package,
lookup_cargo_crate, lookup_go_module, lookup_github_repo,
lookup_business, lookup_business_by_org, query_commitment.

## GitHub Action

  - uses: piiiico/commit-action@v1
    with:
      fail-on-critical: true
      comment-on-pr: true

Posts audit results as a PR comment. Auto-detects packages from
package.json, requirements.txt, Cargo.toml, go.mod.

## IDE Hooks

  poc hook              # installs for both Cursor and Claude Code
  poc hook --cursor     # Cursor only
  poc hook --claude-code # Claude Code only

Intercepts npm/pip/cargo/go install commands and blocks CRITICAL packages.

## Scoring

0–100 score based on:
- Publisher depth: how many people can publish to npm/PyPI/crates.io
- Release consistency: regular releases signal active oversight
- Download momentum: growth trends
- Longevity: how long the package has existed
- OpenSSF Scorecard: process security (code review, branch protection)

Risk flags:
- CRITICAL: sole publisher + >10M weekly downloads
- HIGH: package <1yr old + rapid adoption
- WARN: no release in 12+ months
